contexts.text: As the priests represented the Lord, who alone fights for man, their office is called warfare. Illustrated in AC 5335:2.
Hence by warfare, and war, are signified the things of spiritual warfare and war. Illustrated.
After they have exercised spiritual warfare. Treated of.
To go forth for warfare () = to go forth into combats against the evils and falsities which are from Hell.
Therefore the ministry of the Levites was called warfare. Illustrated.
Those in warfare who love nothing but slaughter and spoils...
That war = spiritual war, which is against infernal things, is evident from the fact that the offices and ministries of the Levites about the Tent are called warfare. Illustrated, Explained.
Thus the priesthood is warfare, but warfare against falsities and evils.
Her warfare is fulfilled () = combat against evils.
